scan.summary: This is the company's own blank monthly checklist with eight lines. It covers air permit posting, scrubber and carbon-bed monitoring, forklift inspections, extinguishers, exits, eyewash stations and showers, and safety data sheets (SDSs). The Month, Completed by, Done, Initials and supervisor review fields are all empty, so it shows that the company has a monthly self-check routine but does not show that any check was actually done. A filled-in, signed copy for each month would be the record worth keeping.
scan.freshness_note: The form has no date, revision number or entries, so its age can't be told from the document. If completed monthly copies exist (for example, August and September 2026), ask for those. They are the evidence this form is meant to produce.

deadlines.title: Report any items marked N to the Plant Manager
deadlines.source_line: Items marked N are reported to the Plant Manager by the 5th of the following month.

deadlines.title: Complete the monthly EHS self-check and get supervisor review

facts.value: The facility has scrubbers S-1 and S-2, monitored by pressure drop, and a carbon unit C-1, checked weekly with detector tubes.
facts.quote: Weekly C-1 detector-tube checks done and recorded every week this month
facts.affects: Confirms the air-permit monitoring duties the company tracks internally.

facts.value: Eyewash stations and safety showers are on site.
facts.quote: Eyewash stations and safety showers flushed this week and logged
facts.affects: A weekly flush log should exist, and corrosives such as 50% sodium hydroxide trigger emergency eyewash and shower requirements.

facts.value: Portable fire extinguishers are on site with annual tags and monthly visual checks.
facts.quote: Fire extinguishers tagged within the last 12 months; monthly visual check initialled on each tag
facts.affects: The annual maintenance certificate (service date August 20, 2025) comes up against the 12-month interval around August 2026.

facts.value: At least one forklift is in use and gets a pre-shift inspection.
facts.quote: Forklift pre-shift inspection log complete for every day the truck ran; any defect followed up
facts.affects: Daily examination records for forklifts are expected.

scan.confidence_notes: I'm confident about what this is: a blank, undated internal template with no entries. Because it is the company's own tool and not a program regulated by a standard, I didn't check it against any rule. A few things may be worth a look. (1) Line 2 gives a pressure-drop range of 2.0 to 6.0 but no units. Compare it with the range in Air Contaminant Discharge Permit 26-2841-ST-01; I didn't check that the two match. (2) Line 7 asks about only 'this week' on a monthly form, so it doesn't confirm that every week's flush happened. (3) Line 5 folds the annual extinguisher service and the monthly visual check into one yes/no answer. (4) I'm not sure the permit actually requires posting (Line 1); that may be a company practice. I inferred the agency and subject labels from what each line covers.
